fact: The EDS-RDC III 2023-24 found 38.3% of urban and 2.4% of rural women aged 15-49, and 59.4% of urban and 8.1% of rural men, used the internet in the previous 12 months.
title: Enquête Démographique et de Santé EDS-RDC III 2023–2024, Rapport final
